content.text: You’re a digital creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan. Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable. You sell ebooks, templates, or fonts. You need to collect payment and deliver files — without platforms that reject your country or currency. This guide explains the exact infrastructure to deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack. No workarounds. No platform dependencies. Own the entire architecture.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

This is a complete commerce infrastructure stack — not a plugin or app. It combines free tools into a system that hosts your products, verifies crypto payments, and delivers files automatically. The stack runs on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments handles crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee. You own every component. No platform can shut you down or charge recurring fees. This is infrastructure sovereignty — built for creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are restricted or unreliable.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The frontend is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. The backend uses Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing and file delivery. When a buyer sends crypto, NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain and fires a webhook. The backend script checks the webhook, logs the order in Supabase or Google Sheets, and sends the buyer a secure download link. Files are stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The system is stateless — no server to manage. The buyer gets their product instantly. You get paid in crypto. The entire process is automated and runs without your intervention. The stack is designed to handle up to 1,000 transactions per day without additional costs.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software in regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. If you’re in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, or the Philippines, this stack gives you a fully operational online store. It’s also for creators who want to own their infrastructure instead of renting it. No platform fees. No buyer accounts required. No KYC. The stack is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe — against actual payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation. That is its credential.
Own the entire stack — no platform can shut you down or charge recurring fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront for free. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic without servers. Supabase or Google Sheets stores order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files securely. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. The stack uses webhooks to automate the entire process. Recommended crypto networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON — under $0.10 per transaction. The system is modular — swap components as needed. For example, replace Google Sheets with Supabase for scalability. Replace Google Drive with Cloudflare R2 for faster global delivery. The stack is designed to evolve with your needs.
